description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Filter::SignificantDigits' which implements a Template Toolkit filter to display numbers with the three most significant digits. It includes methods for initialization and filtering, utilizing external utility functions.

classes.name: Coocook::Filter::SignificantDigits
classes.description: A Perl package implementing a Template Toolkit filter for formatting numbers with significant digits.

methods.description: Initializes the filter plugin and installs the 'significant_digits' filter.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies the significant_digits utility function to format the input number.
